facts.raw_span: A young black woman with sickle cell disease (HbSS variant)
2-day history of visual loss in the left eye

peripheral retinal black sunburst lesions

abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula, with increased intercapillary spacing and small areas of hypofluorescence nasal to the fovea

Temporal macular thinning
Normal cilioretinal, retinal arteriolar, and retinal venous filling
retinal atrophy
